title: Punch List Density by Room
dataSources: Schedules (`reno:gantt`), punch lists (`reno:punchlist`), photo logs (`reno:photo`), permits (`reno:permit`), project controls (`reno:ops`).
app: Home-renovation project telemetry — Gantt plans, punch-list updates, inspection photo logs, and permit expiry trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via builder-tool exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reno:punchlist room=*
| stats count as punch_list_items by room
| sort - punch_list_items
description: Ranks room by punch-list items volume for room-level work.
value: Volume rankings show which room are producing the most activity, demand, or friction inside room-level work.
implementation: Capture each punch-list items as a `reno:punchlist` event and normalize `room` so the totals are comparable.
visualization: Bar chart of punch-list items volume by room.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges which room show up the most in room-level work so you know where the busiest areas are.
